Floryn's primary healing skill. It restores HP for multiple targets.

Floryn tosses an Energy Seed at the target enemy, dealing 180( +100% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage). Healing Fruits will then spawn and bounce to nearby allied heroes, restoring their (HP) by 175( +90% Total Magic Power).
Floryn's primary damage and control skill. Use it to poke and control enemies.

Floryn resonates with Dew's power, restoring 250( +100% Total Magic Power) (HP) to all allied heroes 2 times no matter where they are on the battlefield. This effect also removes any Healing Reduction or Shield Reduction effects on allied heroes, and makes them immune to those effects for 2s.
Use this skill to heal all your allies without distance limitation and turn the tide!

Dew's (Lantern) will permanently increase Floryn's attributes by a small amount.\nAfter leaving combat for 5s, Floryn can share the (Flower of Hope) with an allied hero (30s cooldown), which will grant them a 150( +80% Total Magic Power) shield each time they are healed by Floryn.\nFloryn will never sell the (Lantern).
Try to hit enemies with Floryn's skills to stack up her Passive to maximize the power of Lantern.
Unique Passive - Lantern of Hope: The equipment's attributes scale with hero level.
Unique Passive - Gift: Regenerates 20% Max HP and Mana over 2s after leveling up.
Unique Passive - Timestream: Hero kills or assists reduce the Ultimate's current cooldown by 30%.
Unique Passive - Bless: Received Shield and HP Regen effects are increased by 30%.
Unique Passive - Immortal: Revives 2.5s after death, gaining 16% Max HP and a 220-1200 shield (scales with level) that lasts 3s (210s cooldown).
